rentals:10:1165369.overview: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.
rentals:10:1165369.title: De Gaulle: Liberté

rentals:10:1219507.overview: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.
rentals:10:1219507.title: In Transit

rentals:10:1626719.overview: A documentary director gathers her friends to document a haunted house, only to witness horrific paranormal activity.
rentals:10:1626719.title: The Wicked Hour

rentals:10:1801857.overview: Harper is on the verge of becoming partner at her prestigious law firm when she's sent home for the holidays to finalize a major real estate deal before Christmas Eve. But her career ambitions are shaken when she discovers the property in question is her hometown's beloved community center — a place filled with cherished memories and the heart of the town's holiday traditions. As Harper reconnects with old friends, family, and the spirit of Christmas, she finds herself torn between professional success and doing what she knows is right. With romance, small-town charm, and heartfelt holiday magic, A Memorable Christmas is a warm and uplifting story about love, second chances, and discovering what truly matters.
rentals:10:1801857.title: A Memorable Christmas

svod:1899:1764131.overview: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.
svod:1899:1764131.title: The Buffalo Miracle

svod:350:1280115.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.
svod:350:1280115.title: Way of the Warrior Kid

svod:8:1599329.overview: Podcaster Winona is forced to test love online by a holiday dating-app partnership, connecting with a mystery man who feels like everything she’s been missing. What she doesn’t know is that he’s Luke, the rugged renovator transforming her grandmother’s Christmas Eve venue — and the last guy she’d ever expect to fall for in real life.
svod:8:1599329.title: All for Christmas

svod:8:1802703.overview: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.
svod:8:1802703.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider

svod:8:1824177.overview: Nate Bargatze brings his dry wit and deadpan charm to overzealous parking sensors, the walking politics of marriage and an unhinged family group chat.
svod:8:1824177.title: Nate Bargatze: Good for Nathan

svod:8:1829270.overview: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.
svod:8:1829270.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing

svod:9:1611767.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.
svod:9:1611767.title: Clashing Through the Snow
